items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: But Willie Humphrey, you know, over there, he was Willie too, and that was Slim.

ctx.x: Ask him if this was before he was with Amos Riley or Amos Riley.

He said, was this before you was with Amos Riley? Yeah, I had to play with Amos Riley too. No, he said, was you with Batiste before Amos Riley? Oh, no way after. Amos Riley Dive used to call him Slim or stick something. Used to call him Slim for a nickname, you know. But Willie Humphrey, you know, over there, he was Willie too, and that was Slim. And Brian Freddie. Slim had to get a lioness. He didn't get a lioness, but he never had to hold him up, you know. Then he had a horn, he had two shanks. They didn't get…
Who was he with before he was with Amos Riley?

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: You see, Willie Humphrey. He won just one best T.O.R. did. One.

ctx.x: Best Tunk player on Clionette. The best player. He said, who was the best Tunk player on Clionette?

Okay. Tunk, you know, in them battle house. Oh, you mean at that time? Yeah, on Clionette. Yeah, that's about the worst I know, you know. Yeah. Well, he's no one. No one. No one. One best. You see, Willie Humphrey. He won just one best T.O.R. did. One. I think Johnny Handler. He was the most gassy player. He was pretty, pretty, you know, Blown Fetty. Blown Fetty. Blown Fetty is a player, he's trying it just like he played a harmonica, you see? Johnny Dott, he was good too, you know.

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1960-01-21
items.q: They're like Willie Hump and all of them.

ctx.x: I'm asking did they have a new Liberty Bell?

So did you have a new Liberty Bell? A new Liberty Bell? New? New? Did they have a new Liberty Bell band? A new Liberty Bell band? No, not after we broke up. But our band got popular. And all of them all the world, they know them. They know them. They're like Willie Hump and all of them. Lewis Armstrong. All them fellas like that. Did you know Amos White? You know Amos White?
I didn't know him. You never know that? He's in California.
